target_evidence: Research/Submission.lean:49-74 proves dotProductBackwardError universally for model : Model and tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ), under only ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1. It produces a same-shape perturbation of exactProductTree tree bounded by gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u, whose exact sum equals roundedDotProduct model tree. Model assumptions are Model.lean:15-19; the conclusion concerns exact products, not already-rounded products.

requirements.requirement: Prove the full universally quantified dot-product backward-error theorem.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:49-74 proves dotProductBackwardError for every Model and Tree (ℝ × ℝ), with only ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1. Its existential conclusion gives both the componentwise bound and equality with roundedDotProduct. Independent /output/Audit.lean compiles successfully against the expanded exact-product and rounded-operation definitions.

requirements.requirement: Relate perturbations to exact componentwise products x_i*y_i.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:14-15 defines exactProductTree using pair.1 * pair.2; the proved conclusion at lines 52-55 explicitly uses this tree. Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:17-23 enforces the same shape and |perturbed leaf - exact leaf| ≤ bound * |exact leaf|, including zero products.

requirements.requirement: Account for one rounded multiplication per leaf.
requirements.evidence: Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean:25-27 defines mul as round (a * b). Research/Submission.lean:28-44 proves the rounded product tree is a model.u perturbation of the exact product tree using round_spec at line 34. This lemma is used in the final proof at lines 62-68.

requirements.requirement: Account for every rounded tree addition in the reduction.
requirements.evidence: Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:11-13 rounds addition at every internal node. Its theorem at lines 112-171 inducts on the depth bound, applies round_spec to each internal-node sum at lines 150-151, and scales both perturbed subtrees by that rounding factor at lines 152-165. Research/Submission.lean:59-61 applies this theorem at tree.depth; Tree.lean:43-47 proves mapping preserves depth.

requirements.requirement: Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
requirements.evidence: Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Gamma.lean:8-9 defines gamma k u = k*u/(1-k*u); lines 33-54 prove the one-error extension bound. Research/Submission.lean:63-73 composes the multiplication bound u with the addition bound gamma depth u as u + gamma depth u * (1 + u), then bounds it by gamma (depth + 1) u. The final witness at line 74 carries that bound.

requirements.requirement: Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:49-55 quantifies unrestricted model and tree and assumes only the required smallness inequality. Model.lean:15-19 supplies nonnegative u and the relative rounding specification, without exact-arithmetic or conclusion assumptions. The addition smallness condition is derived at Submission.lean:56-58. Independent Lean axiom inspection reports only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound; /evaluation/verification.json and verification.log report a successful build with no placeholders or custom axioms.
